title: Nrf-2/ROS/NF-kappaB pathway is modulated by cynarin in human mesenchymal stem cells in vitro from ankylosing spondylitis.
authors: Song, Chenyu; Wang, Kaiyang; Qian, Bangping; Lu, Jingshun; Qiao, Mu; Qiu, Yong; Wang, Bin; Yu, Yang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究菜蓟素对强直性脊柱炎间充质干细胞的抗炎抗氧化作用，涉及Nrf-2/NF-kappaB通路及分子对接，但核心是细胞信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is an immune chronic inflammatory disease, resulting in back pain, stiffness, and thoracolumbar kyphotic deformity. Based on the reported anti-inflammatory and antioxidant capacities of cynarin (Cyn), this study explored its protective role and molecular mechanisms in mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) from AS. The target pathways and genes were verified using Western blotting, quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction, and immunofluorescent staining, while molecular docking analysis was conducted. In AS-MSCs, we found that the expression levels of p-NF-kappaB, IL-6, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha were higher and IkappaB-alpha, Nrf-2, and HO-1 were lower compared with healthy control (HC)-MSCs. With molecular docking analysis, the biding affinities between Cyn and Keap1-Nrf-2 and p65-IkappaB-alpha were predicted. The mRNA and protein expression of p-NF-kappaB, IL-6, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha and the reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation were downregulated following Cyn administration. Meanwhile, the expression level of IkappaB-alpha, Nrf-2, and HO-1 were significantly increased after Cyn pretreatment. The results suggested that the protective mechanisms of Cyn in AS-MSCs were based on enhancing the antioxidation and suppression of excessive inflammatory responses via Nrf-2/ROS/NF-kappaB axis. Our findings demonstrate that Cyn is a potential candidate for alleviating inflammation in AS.
abstract_zh: 强直性脊柱炎（ankylosing spondylitis, AS）是一种免疫性慢性炎症性疾病，导致背痛、僵硬及胸腰椎后凸畸形。基于已报道的菜蓟素（cynarin, Cyn）的抗炎和抗氧化能力，本研究探讨了其在AS来源的间充质干细胞（mesenchymal stem cells, MSCs）中的保护作用及分子机制。通过Western blotting、实时定量聚合酶链反应和免疫荧光染色验证了靶向通路和基因，并进行了分子对接分析。在AS-MSCs中，我们发现与健康对照（HC）-MSCs相比，p-NF-kappaB、IL-6、IL-1beta和TNF-alpha的表达水平较高，而IkappaB-alpha、Nrf-2和HO-1的表达水平较低。通过分子对接分析，预测了Cyn与Keap1-Nrf-2和p65-IkappaB-alpha之间的结合亲和力。Cyn处理后，p-NF-kappaB、IL-6、IL-1beta和TNF-alpha的mRNA和蛋白表达以及活性氧（ROS）生成均下调。同时，Cyn预处理后，IkappaB-alpha、Nrf-2和HO-1的表达水平显著增加。结果表明，Cyn在AS-MSCs中的保护机制基于通过Nrf-2/ROS/NF-kappaB轴增强抗氧化作用并抑制过度炎症反应。我们的发现表明，Cyn是缓解AS炎症的潜在候选药物。
